description: This Mendeley Data version 3 release contains airflow and turbulence measurements around a one-to-fifty-scale asymmetric dairy-barn model in a Potsdam boundary-layer wind tunnel. Researchers used two-dimensional laser Doppler anemometry, with a reported 233 measurement positions across an internal and external section. The public file list has four raw-data ZIP archives, four analysis workbooks and an STL model geometry under CC BY 4.0. The article also describes empty-tunnel wind-profile checks used to characterize incoming flow. Coverage is a scaled physical model under controlled boundary-layer conditions, not a measured operating barn through multiple seasons. Reynolds scaling, simplified geometry and one tunnel setup limit direct inference of full-scale ventilation or emissions. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is checking computational-fluid-dynamics flow fields before modelling naturally ventilated livestock housing. model-openfoam is a related CFD engine, but no case files or model run were verified. The raw archives, spreadsheets and STL were not downloaded or inspected.
